Type: ottoman
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Lyon Upholstered Ottoman, 45.5"W, Linen
Colors: Linen
The generous size of this fully padded ottoman provides plenty of room for putting your feet up and relaxing. The clean, modern lines and linen-colored upholstery bring a distinctive flair to your living room or family room. Durable, easy-care performance fabric makes cleaning a breeze. 45.5"W x 25.5"D x 20"H; leg height: 6"H Upholstered in 100% polyester fabric; fully padded solid wood frame with mortise and tenon construction Sinuous spring support system with durable foam-padded cushions Assemble in 15 minutes or less Spills should be spot cleaned and rinsed with water. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This item is made to order just for you.
